key_concepts: The human body has three types of muscle: skeletal, smooth, and cardiac.
Skeletal muscles move the body and are attached to bones.
Smooth muscles work involuntarily to digest food and keep blood and air flowing.
Cardiac muscle pumps blood continuously without resting.
The muscular system has over 600 muscles and supports movement, posture, heat production,
Muscles contract and relax to produce movement.

The axial skeleton includes the skull, rib cage, and spinal column.

The appendicular skeleton includes the pelvic girdle, shoulder girdle, and limb bones.
Bone marrow inside bones makes red blood cells.
Muscles and bones work together to enable movement.
